claims.statement: All 54 non-tied states in each family at each tested softmax temperature have a positive-profit negative-welfare learning interaction under the primary mask and rival-wait condition.
claims.assumptions: PROTOCOL.md; H2 fixed initial focal policy, epsilon=0.1, alpha=0.5; five specified temperatures; stipulated grid only
claims.proof_status: finite numerical enclosures; not Lean verified
claims.denominator: 54 states per family and temperature, not trained populations
claims.prohibited_wording: always privately profitable; generic AI harm; all learning algorithms

claims.statement: Total conflict is less robust than its learning interaction: active-plus-shadow cases yield 45/54 at tau=.1 and 51/54 at each other tested tau.
claims.assumptions: same as R1; total includes direct strategic component

claims.statement: At cost .05, mutual waiting is both the unique pure equilibrium and planner choice at every tested state for tau=.5, 1, 2.
claims.assumptions: same four-profile menu and information; focal learning off, rival on; specified real cost
claims.proof_status: interval-verified finite pure-profile inequalities, not a general equilibrium theorem
claims.denominator: 109 states at each of three temperatures
claims.prohibited_wording: the planner always disagrees; all mixed equilibria computed

claims.statement: Under the smooth H2 contract in THEORY.md, the focal deployment's gross welfare effect is strictly negative for arbitrary finite rival tables when alpha>0, epsilon<1 and tau>0 finite.
claims.assumptions: THEORY.md section 1; own learning off; rival waits and learns; focal active/shadow swap; exact six-atom economy
claims.proof_status: post-hoc analytical proof, AI-assisted internal review; not formalized
claims.denominator: analytical quantified statement; numerical check covers only 545 state/temperature points
claims.prohibited_wording: new universal theorem; privately optimal harm for every state; systemic instability

claims.statement: Strict inequalities persist in some local neighborhood under positive-temperature smooth choice, without a calculated radius.
claims.assumptions: finite horizon, finite economic/action support, smooth policy, affine selected updates; strict point inequality
claims.proof_status: elementary continuity argument, not a novelty or Lean claim
claims.denominator: local existence only; no global interpolation between grid points
